complexity.rationale: Delete one JSX element in HomeView.tsx and update its component tests; no state, API, dependency or TorusWidget change.

capabilityOwners.rationale: Removal of a rendered element only.

component.rationale: What HomeView renders is the behaviour under change.

integration.rationale: No cross-module behaviour; the component test renders the real HomeView and TorusWidget.

e2e.rationale: Static markup removal with no user flow.

increments.behavior: HomeView renders only the green torus widget; the red torus widget is gone.
increments.doneWhen: The updated HomeView component tests pass and the other component tests, lint and build still pass.

tests.description: HomeView renders exactly one torus widget with data-color green, has no 'Red Torus Widget' region, and the torus row contains only the green torus.

expectedRedEvidence.expectedFailure: Expected one torus widget but HomeView still renders two, the second being red.

verification.requirement: npm run test:component passes, and npm run lint and npm run build are clean
